_source: Brand tags for forms and surveys (2026-09-04). build/apply_brand_tags.py sets each style key to {{ brandboards.<key> }} AND writes the palette's current hex into the builder's cached computedStyles (the public page renders from that cache; GHL only regenerates it when the design is saved in the builder, so a palette change is pushed to forms/surveys by re-running this script). Palette values must be unique: the builder links colors to tags by value.
